texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Why Tempo?: I have been building stablecoin infrastructure since before it was a category: at Everex (Singapore, 2017-2018) I was Chief Engineer for Lending & Risk Management, wrote the smart contracts and led government/bank relations across SE Asia on structuring crypto payments and stablecoins. Later I designed one of the first detailed frameworks for a national government to issue its own stablecoins (regulatory + token-economic design). Tempo treats payments as the core workload of the chain, which is exactly the thesis I have worked toward for a decade. On the security side: MSc in Computer & Information Systems Security (MEPhI, cryptography), smart-contract audit background, and anti-fraud instincts from adversarial crypto markets (exchange backends, market-maker engines). Today I build guardrails for production AI-agent fleets (agent-leash, verbatim-citation-gate) - I run the attack surface I defend.
texts.Provide (2) examples of your exceptional: 1) claw-consensus: reproducible multi-machine agent consensus across my 6-machine production Claude fleet, with published evals and FAILURE-MODES.md - measured 0/17 high-risk actions slipping past the human approval gate. 2) Everex (Singapore): smart contracts for blockchain credit scoring and stable-value payments, plus crypto-exchange market-maker engines and HFT backends shipped at Platinum.
